'''Charles''' "'''Bo'''" '''Outlaw''' (born April 13, 1971) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. He was born in [[San Antonio, Texas]], and is a 1989 alumnus of [[John Jay High School (San Antonio)|John Jay High School]].<ref>[https://www.sanantoniomag.com/five-nba-stars-that-hail-from-san-antonio/ Five NBA Stars that Hail from San Antonio]</ref>

Outlaw led the Mustangs to a 38–0 record his senior year before losing to Clear Lake High School in the state championship game. Outlaw played for [[South Plains College]] and the [[University of Houston]]. During his time in Houston, he averaged 14.0 [[points per game|ppg]], 9.1 [[rebounds per game|rpg]], and led [[NCAA Division I]] with a [[field goal percentage]] of .684. In 1993, he declared eligibility for the [[1993 NBA draft|NBA draft]] but was not selected.

After playing one season apiece for the Celtics and the [[Orlando Magic]] in the NBA, he started a journeyman playing career, mostly in Europe.
